description_en: Checks whether a password is set for a simple application server
description_zh: 查询轻量应用服务器是否设置过密码
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-instance-passwords-setting --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstancePasswordsSetting

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361076.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361076.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.name: instance_id

InstancePasswordSetting.description_en: Indicates whether a logon password is set for the simple application server
InstancePasswordSetting.description_zh: 是否设置过轻量应用服务器密码

VncPasswordSetting.description_en: Indicates whether a VNC connection password is set for the simple application server
